services.desc: Starting July 19, 2026, The Warehouse will be closed in preparation for upcoming exhibitions WAREHOUSE:01 Yukinori Yanagi and In Our Image: The Fragile Body in Contemporary Art, opening September 26, 2026. Visit our Upcoming Exhibitions page to learn more. The Warehouse offers guided Group Tours for high school, university, architecture, museum, and organized art education groups. Group Tours are available Tuesday-Friday from 10am to 5pm for groups of 10-40 people. If your group has more than 40 guests or needs to schedule for a different day, please add these details to the Notes section of the Group Tour Request Form. blurb: The Warehouse presents original exhibitions of artworks from significant institutions and private collections. These changing exhibitions are developed specifically to suggest new perspectives on art and invite fresh questions that expand accepted notions of history. The Warehouse presents 2-3 exhibitions a year.
